ja: コミックボンボンで好評連載中の「SDガンダム英雄伝」から、謎の少年「勇座」が乗る「武者ガンダム」がプラモデルで登場。
光輝く鎧をメッキと、特殊塗装で再現。太刀などの各種武器が付属。
また、BB戦士オリジナルのカスタム戦馬も付き、合体もできる。
en: From "SD Gundam Eiden", which is currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon, "Musha Gundam", ridden by the mysterious boy "Yuza", is now available as a plastic model.
Reproduce the shining armor with plating and special painting. Various weapons such as a sword are included.
It also comes with a BB Senshi original custom war horse that can be combined.
